text.en: Repeal. EO No. 340 (s. 2004) is hereby expressly repealed.

Powers of the SBMA Board. The powers of the SBMA, as
defined under RA No. 7227, shall be exercised by the SBMA Board of Directors.

SBMA Administrator and Chairman of the SBMA Board. The
President shall appoint the Administrator of the SBMA, who shall be the ex officio
Chairman of the SBMA Board.
SECTION. 4. Powers and Duties of the SBMA Administrator. The
Administrator, who shall be the Chief Executive Officer of the SBMA, shall have the
following powers, functions and duties:
a. To execute, administer and implement the policies and measures
approved and adopted by the SBMA Board;
b. To directly administer and supervise the operations and day-to-day
business activities of the SBMA:
To exercise the powers of control and supervision over decisions and
actions of subordinate officers;
d. To appoint, transfer, remove, suspend or otherwise discipline any
employee of the SBMA in accordance with law;
e. To represent the SBMA in all dealings with offices, agencies and
instrumentalities of the Government and with all persons and entities,
public or private, domestic or foreign, unless otherwise directed by the
President or by the SBMA Board;
To sign all permits, certificates, authorizations, and other official
documents issued by the SBMA in the exercise of its governmental,
regulatory, proprietary, and commercial powers;
g. To execute, on behalf of the SBMA, all contracts, agreements and
other instruments affecting the interests of the SBMA or where the
SBMA is a contracting party, duly approved by the SBMA Board;
h. To direct and supervise the preparation of the agenda for the
meetings of the SBMA Board;
1. To preside at the meetings of the SBMA Board; and
].
To perform such other functions and duties as the President may
direct, or as may be assigned to him/her by the SBMA Board.

Separability. If any provision of this Order is held invalid or
unconstitutional, the other provisions not otherwise affected shall remain in full force

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 25thdaySeptembein the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Seventeen.
By the Président:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
